justification: The assessment identifies the same invalid Case-1 application. At m=2^k, (10 log_2 m)/m^{-1/2}=10k·2^{k/2} is unbounded, so the required Big-O hypothesis fails. Unrolling gives S(2^k)=S(1)+5k(k+1), confirming that Θ(1) is false; the different base value changes only an additive constant.
